vocabulary.meaning_en: a small word that shows place, time or direction, like at, on, in, by
ways of travelling, like car, bus, plane
a car, bus, train or other machine that carries people
vocabulary.example: A bus is a large vehicle.
What is the location of the hotel?

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that does not follow the rule
vocabulary.example: "Bicycle" is an exception: we say "on a bicycle".

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long vehicle that runs on rails
vocabulary.example: I read a book on the train.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that flies and carries people
vocabulary.example: We were on the plane for five hours.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a vehicle that travels on water
vocabulary.example: He is in a small boat on the lake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride with your legs
vocabulary.example: My son goes to school on his bicycle.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
the top or outside part of something
vocabulary.example: The book is on the surface of the table.
The shop is near my house.

vocabulary.note_en: Here "close" is said with an /s/ sound.
vocabulary.example: The school is close to the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the greatest amount or the latest time allowed
vocabulary.example: Friday is the time limit for the homework.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the number and street where a place is
vocabulary.example: Meet me at 51 King Street. That's the address.

fine_lines.title: in a car vs on a bus
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول in مع السيارة والتاكسي (مركبة صغيرة خاصة). ونقول on مع الحافلة والقطار والطائرة والسفينة الكبيرة (مركبات كبيرة نتشاركها مع الناس). الدراجة استثناء: on a bicycle. والقارب الصغير: in a boat.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "in" for a car or taxi (small, private). Use "on" for a bus, train, plane or big boat (large, shared). Exceptions: on a bicycle; in a small boat.

fine_lines.title: by car vs in the car
fine_lines.explanation_ar: by + وسيلة النقل (بدون the) تخبر كيف وصلت: by car, by plane. أما in/on فتخبر أين أنت داخل المركبة الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "By" + transport (no "the") tells how you travelled: by car, by plane. "In/on" tells where you are: in the car, on the plane.

examples.sentence: My bag is in the car.

fine_lines.title: on the table vs in the box
fine_lines.explanation_ar: on: فوق سطح ويمكنك رؤيته. in: داخل شيء له جدران أو حدود.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "On": on top of a surface, you can see it. "In": inside something with walls around it.

examples.sentence: The pen is on the table.
The pen is in the box.

expressions.meaning_en: Which transport did you use to come?
Come to my house to meet me.
expressions.example: Meet me at my house at six.

expressions.phrase: I need it done by tonight.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحتاجه منجزًا قبل الليلة (الليلة كحد أقصى).
expressions.example: Please send the report. I need it done by tonight.

expressions.phrase: What time will I meet you?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for the time of a meeting.

grammar.title: Transportation: on, in, by
grammar.explanation_ar: on مع المركبات الكبيرة المشتركة: on the bus, on the train, on the plane, on a (big) boat. in مع السيارة والتاكسي: in my car, in a taxi. استثناءات: on a bicycle دائمًا، و in a small boat. by + وسيلة النقل للتعبير عن طريقة السفر: by car, by train.
grammar.explanation_en: "On" for large shared vehicles: on the bus, train, plane, big boat. "In" for a car or taxi. Exceptions: always "on a bicycle"; "in a small boat". "By" + transport tells how you travel: by car, by train.

grammar.title: Location: at, on, in, by
grammar.explanation_ar: at لمكان محدد كنقطة أو عنوان: at my house, at 51 King Street. on فوق سطح أو مساحة: on the table, on the floor. in داخل مكان له جدران: in a room, in a box. by بمعنى قريب من (near / close to): by the door.
grammar.explanation_en: "At" for an exact point or address: at my house. "On" for a surface: on the table, on the floor. "In" for inside something with walls: in a room, in a box. "By" means near / close to: by the door.
examples: The book is on the table.
The chair is by the window.

grammar.title: Time: at, on, in, by
grammar.explanation_ar: at لوقت محدد بالساعة: at 9:15. on للأيام وكل ما فيه كلمة day: on Monday, on my birthday. in للفترات الطويلة: الأشهر والسنوات والأسابيع: in September, in 1992. by لآخر موعد (لا بعده): by tonight.
grammar.explanation_en: "At" for clock times: at 9:15. "On" for days (anything with "day"): on Monday, on my birthday. "In" for longer periods: months, years, weeks: in September, in 1992. "By" for a deadline, not later than: by tonight.

questions.question: "I read a book ___ the train."
questions.explanation_ar: القطار مركبة كبيرة مشتركة: on the train.
questions.explanation_en: A train is a large shared vehicle: on the train.
